scope: Experimental fixed-source evidence preparation, evidence packing and reader input auditing
validation_kind: CPU-only synthetic unit checks; no model or tokenizer was loaded
verified_contracts: Fixed source and question fingerprint binding
Exact source spans and explicit omission ranges
Research/chat prompt selection without mutable global state
Actual encoded input length and canonical fingerprints; explicit overflow rejection
limitations: Synthetic checks do not establish retrieval recall or answer quality.
Unicode character budgets are not model-token budgets.
Additional source/author formatting can displace text in small budgets.
The packer remains experimental; a larger budget is a separate comparison.
